vendor/mini-photo.js is the GifOS classic-IIFE wrap of xdadda/mini-photo-editor's
crop / rotate / filter loop. Upstream is mini-js + mini-gl (local file:
packages, ESM). GifOS inlines classic scripts, so the jobs are re-hosted on
a 2D canvas. MTX looks (polaroid, kodak, vintage, browni) match their
_filters.js names.

package: xdadda/mini-photo-editor
url:     https://github.com/xdadda/mini-photo-editor
commit:  475a0e9dcb5bb6925d9b7f3c522a1312aeefad3d (main)
COPYING-mini-photo-editor.txt  MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 xdadda

LUT PNG Instagram-style maps, heal brush, perspective, histogram and exif
are not in this wrap. Take photo is a brokered still. The photo stays on
this device (saved in the file with the recipe). Invite shares the
recipe, not the picture. Crop is a handle box over the still, not a
cut-and-forget.
